why: Reran the harness on the live app.html (weaponJoins is identical to the todo copy) on all 20 real units and the 24 made-up ones. The output matches the fix tested for w1, except that carrier tags keep the short name, as intended. Close-quarters: the ranged "or" now carries the rule's own condition, "When using another shooting type" (Deffkoptas in both lists: "Rokkit Launcha ×3 / or · when using another shooting type / Slugga ×3"). When only some models with these weapons have both kinds, it returns null and useLine's per-model sentence is shown. That happened for 2× Nob [Kustom Shoota, Slugga] + Shoota Boyz + Slugga Boyz, Nob + Kaptin with different guns, pistol-only + both + gun-only, and 4× Tankbusta + Tankbusta w/ Pistol. No real unit falls back. MONSTER/VEHICLE models still get no "or" ("excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models"). Extra Attacks: "+" is named when not every line carrying the weapon or a main weapon has the two together: "Choppa ×4 / + Nob / Squig Jaws ×2", "Klaw / + Nob Jaws / + Boss Tail", "Big Choppa ×2 / + Nob / Squig Jaws ×6". The single-model cases are unchanged and still match "All of that model's [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons. One of that model's other melee weapons, if possible". Select Weapons: scopes now keep " w/…": "A ×2 or Boy w/ A / B ×4 or Boy w/ C / C ×2". Breaka Boyz "Choppa or Nob Smash Hammer ×4" is unchanged, and A|B, B|C, A|C still falls back to the sentence. The layout no longer shows a choice or combination that the three rule texts don't give. Carrier tags with the short name ("Knucklebustas – Breaka Boy", "Kustom Mega-blasta – Deffkopta") are display labels and true. Still latent, no change needed: big tests the whole attached unit's keywords where the text says "each model … (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models)"; no list has a mixed unit, and data.js has no per-model keywords. isCQ counts a weapon as [CLOSE-QUARTERS] when any one profile has it (Mork's Roar); this matters only if Ghazghkull had another gun.
